notes: Baseline for the v52_advanced stream (cfm_agent_v_5_2, every LLM call on gemini-3.5-flash). Deliberately empty: an empty settings_overlay plus an identity layer means the agent runs exactly as shipped, so v001 is a true no-op and every later version is a measurable delta from it. This stream keeps its own ledger rather than sharing v50_lite's because a calibration is fitted against one agent's realized error under one LLM -- carrying v5.0's constants across would assert a transfer nothing has measured. Note the overlay may never name an LLM field (CalibrationLedger.to_agent_settings rejects it): which model answered is an identity fact about the run stream, not something a fit is allowed to change. Drift in cfm_agent_v_5_2's own defaults is caught by RunRecord.package_fingerprint, which hashes MANIFEST.sha256, rather than by pinning values here. effective_from predates all available data on purpose: these are the constants v5.2 ships with, so v001 was in force for any cutoff a replay might ask about.
